data.hook: We brought home bed bugs from our family trip, but this plug-in device eliminated them in just two days.

data.script_structure: result-first hook → symptoms in kids → discovery of bug → failed DIY → shame and isolation → exterminator chemicals and relapse → breaking point → friend's tip: PestLab → skeptical try, two-day result → mechanism → six months later → guarantee, sell-out CTA
data.mechanism_reveal: Claim: 'ultrasonic and electromagnetic waves that reach deep into your walls', 'mess with the bed bugs' nervous system so they can't mate or multiply' and 'confuse their sense of smell so they can't even find us'
data.proof: Testimonial story; '2 days' graphic; six-months result; 90-day money-back guarantee badge
data.cta: Pest Lab sells out fast, so if it's still in stock, grab it before they sell out again. End card: LIMITED SUPPLY! 90 Days Money Back Guarantee, CHECK AVAILABILITY
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The long story walks through every option the viewer may already have tried, so the product arrives after the exterminator has failed. Child-focused details (scratching, teasing, crying) carry the emotion while the price contrast does the selling.
data.transferable_move: Tell the result first, then replay the full failed-solutions ladder ending in the expensive pro option failing, so a cheap fix from a friend feels earned. Soften: keep it to sleep, itching and stress, not health damage.
